learningCopilot.copilotPath.description: Path to Copilot CLI executable (e.g., 'copilot' on macOS, or 'C:\\Users\\you\\copilot.exe' on Windows lab machines).

learningCopilot.autoInstallCopilotCli.description: If true, Learning Copilot can offer to install Copilot CLI automatically when it is missing.

learningCopilot.copilotArgs.description: Extra args passed to Copilot CLI.

enumDescriptions: Use the VS Code Language Model API when a Copilot model is available (requires the GitHub Copilot Chat extension), otherwise fall back to the Copilot CLI.
Always use the VS Code Language Model API (requires the GitHub Copilot Chat extension, signed in).
learningCopilot.transport.description: How Learning Copilot talks to the model.

learningCopilot.modelFamily.description: Preferred model family for the Language Model API (e.g. 'gpt-4o'). Leave empty to pick the available Copilot model with the largest context window.
